title: Territory Account Executive, Commercial (Germany)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.</p> <p>This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.</p></div><h3><strong>The Role</strong></h3> <p>The <strong>Territory Account Executive</strong> (TAE) is a key growth role within Everpure (formerly Pure Storage) Germany's Go-To-Market organisation. This position focuses on driving growth across all accounts not currently managed by an Account Executive, including the full install base, dormant accounts, and new inbound opportunities. TAEs are responsible for expanding Pure’s footprint, reigniting customer relationships, and capturing new business through a combination of direct engagement and partner collaboration.<br><br>As a Territory Account Executive (TAE), you’ll play a pivotal role in bringing this vision to life - helping customers unlock the power of their data, modernise their infrastructure, and accelerate transformation. You’ll <strong>join our Commercial team in Germany</strong>, with the autonomy to own a dynamic territory, driving growth across a broad set of customers, from re-engaging dormant relationships to winning new logos.</p> <p>At Pure, you’ll join a culture built on curiosity, innovation, and integrity. We celebrate diverse perspectives, challenge convention, and empower our people to think big, take bold action, and make a measurable impact. This is your opportunity to grow your career with one of the most innovative technology companies in the world and to do work that truly changes how businesses use data to compete and win.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Drive Account Growth &amp; Pipeline:</strong> Execute sales activities to generate revenue, manage a high-volume pipeline, and contribute to closing deals on a quarterly basis.</li> <li><strong>Execute Outreach &amp; Prospecting:</strong> Perform consistent, high-activity prospecting to penetrate new accounts, reach decision-makers, and learn how to win new business effectively.</li> <li><strong>Support Partner Strategy:</strong> Collaborate closely with Channel Partners and Partner Managers to align on customer engagement and utilise partner resources to advance opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Reactivate Customer Relationships:</strong> Focus on re-engaging dormant or inactive customers by discovering new business use cases and identifying potential refresh and expansion opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Build Foundational Skills:</strong> Develop and deliver proposals and business cases that clearly demonstrate the value of Pure's solutions, supported by internal experts.</li> <li><strong>Maintain Sales Discipline:</strong> Diligently manage sales technology (Salesforce), deliver accurate forecasts, and maintain strong time management to thrive in a fast-paced, team environment.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You Bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Proven Sales Experience:</strong> Demonstrated success in direct, full-lifecycle B2B technology sales with a consistent record of meeting or exceeding sales metrics (KPIs).</li> <li><strong>Sales Drive &amp; Motivation:</strong> A high degree of self-motivation, strong time management skills, demonstrates initiative and the drive to learn quickly and succeed across both transactional and early-stage strategic sales motions.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Collaborative Mindset:</strong> Demonstrated success working with both internal teams and channel partners to ensure seamless customer engagement and shared goal achievement.</li> <li><strong>Digital Proficiency:</strong> Proficiency with core sales technologies, including Salesforce and G Suite, and an ability to use data to prioritise daily activities.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Communication &amp; Presence:</strong> Strong verbal and written communication skills suitable for engaging with business leaders and maintaining professional business relationships.</li> <li><strong>Resilience &amp; Focus:</strong> A competitive, positive attitude combined with strong organisational and time management skills necessary to handle a dynamic, high-activity territory.</li> <li><strong>Language Skills: </strong>Business Level, written and spoken, German and English language skills required.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Industry Knowledge:</strong> Prior knowledge of the storage industry and familiarity with how data solutions drive business outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Channel Sales Expertise:</strong> Understanding of channel-led sales motions and experience collaborating effectively within the broader partner ecosystem.</li> <li><strong>Sales Training:</strong> Completion of a structured B2B sales methodology training (e.g., Business Value Selling or similar).</li> <li><strong>Digital Tools:</strong> Experience using digital prospecting and engagement tools (e.g., Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) to accelerate the sales cycle.</li> </ul> <p>Join Everpure Germany team and be part of a team that's redefining data storage. Apply now and unleash your potential!</p> <p>#LI-OFFICE</p> <h3><br><br></h3><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Innovation</strong>: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.</li> <li><strong>Growth</strong>: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!</li> <li><strong>Team</strong>: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.</li> </ul> <p>And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out <a href="http://benefits.everpuredata.com/">http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ </a>for more information.</p> <p><strong>ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:</strong></p> <p>Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at <a ---------- if you’re invited to an interview.</p> <p><strong>OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:</strong></p> <p>We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.</p> <p>Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.</p> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Join us and bring your best.</strong></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Bring your bold.</strong></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Pure and simple.</strong></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: adjoe is redefining the future of mobile ads. Powered by advanced AI, first-party data and world-class engineers, we’ve perfected the offerwall experience for monetizing and scaling app publishers with solutions like Playtime and Arcade – now the fastest growing rewarded advertising channel globally – driving incremental engagement, retention, and revenue. At the same time, we’re breaking into programmatic advertising with the intelligent bidding system of adjoe Ads. Together, this ecosystem connects app developers to over 600 million users worldwide for scalable growth. Backed by a $100 million investment from Bertelsmann and operating from offices in Hamburg, Boston, Singapore, and Tokyo, adjoe is defining the next stages of app and ad experience – right now. Join us. Where Talent Ambitions Meets Product Strategy The Employee Experience team designs and operates the programs and initiatives that shape how people join, grow, and perform at adjoe. The full employee lifecycle, built to support a high-performance organization ready to build ad technologies that reach every user on the globe. The work sits at the intersection of people strategy and execution. On one side, designing structured programs that raise the bar: performance frameworks, development initiatives, and the onboarding experience that sets the standard from day one. On the other, building adjoe's employer brand externally — telling our story on how we solve biggest adtech challenges. Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For: You bring 5+ years of experience in employer branding, specifically within the tech industry. You will define and evolve our Employer Value Proposition, showcasing real employee journeys and career development paths across video, podcasts, social channels, and external platforms. We are looking for someone who loves connecting with people and bringing authentic human and tech stories to life. You will build and manage an active engineering blog pipeline and tech content strategy. You will partner directly with developers, tech leads, and directors to translate complex backend systems and tech pillars into engaging articles, stories, and social posts. You will produce your own content hands-on while also briefing and directing designers, videographers, photographers, and content writers. You are comfortable scripting video concepts, leading shoots, and working closely with creative teams to deliver polished visual assets. You will audit and refine our career website, external company profiles, and job description copy to ensure our employee experience, culture, and impact-driven roles are accurately reflected for global talent. You will support developers in speaking at top tech conferences by helping build compelling presentation decks, abstracts, and talk tracks. You bring a balance of big-picture strategy and daily execution. You are equally excited to map out long-term talent attraction campaigns as you are to jump on camera, write copy, or collaborate directly with an engineer to draft a tech piece. What's in It for You? At adjoe, we're designing the organization behind one of the fastest-growing adtech platforms in mobile. The initiatives you build, the talent you develop, and the culture you shape will directly influence how adjoe scales globally. Go Big. Own programs that have real impact on how 250+ people across 7 offices join, grow, and perform. Move Fast. Operate in a high-velocity environment where you design, test, and iterate on people programs with the same mindset as a product team. Be Direct. Work in a culture where feedback is honest, collaboration is real, and your ideas get heard. Thrive Together. Grow alongside a diverse, global team of 250+ people from over 40 countries — and help make that experience better for everyone. Have Fun. Build meaningful programs, celebrate the people behind the product, and bring your energy to a team that genuinely enjoys what they do. 🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the Role: At Camunda, we are evolving how software gets built. We are looking for a Product Builder to help shape the enterprise and governance experience of Camunda Hub by combining product thinking, user empathy, UX judgment, and hands-on execution. This is a high-ownership role inside our Products organization for someone who wants to move quickly, work directly with customers and forward deployed engineers, and build in an AI-first environment. Camunda Hub is the unified management platform through which teams govern their processes, manage access, and administer the platform at enterprise scale. raw.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

At Camunda, we are evolving how software gets built. We are looking for a Product Builder to help shape the enterprise and governance experience of Camunda Hub by combining product thinking, user empathy, UX judgment, and hands-on execution. This is a high-ownership role inside our Products organization for someone who wants to move quickly, work directly with customers and forward deployed engineers, and build in an AI-first environment.

Camunda Hub is the unified management platform through which teams govern their processes, manage access, and administer the platform at enterprise scale. You will join the Enterprise & Governance pod, which owns the surfaces enterprise Centres of Excellence and platform administrators rely on: access control and permissions, workspace and tenant management, audit and compliance features, and the administration and configuration UI for clusters and platform settings.

The role will contribute across the full stack, enabling faster end-to-end product delivery.

What you'll be doing:

  •  Discover and clarify meaningful user problems for administrators, CoE teams, and enterprise architects by working closely with customers, forward deployed engineers, and internal stakeholders

  • Shape product direction through practical judgment, fast iteration, and a strong focus on solving the underlying problem rather than only implementing requests

  • Prototype, build, harden, ship, and iterate on product improvements across the enterprise and governance surfaces of Hub - access control, workspace and tenant management, audit and compliance, and platform administration

  • Use AI tools effectively to accelerate first drafts, implementation steps, iteration, and learning while maintaining a strong quality bar

  • Work closely with other builders and product strategy counterparts to turn ideas into shipped outcomes, including across boundaries with Core / Identity where governance surfaces build on platform contracts

  • Improve the speed, quality, and effectiveness of how the pod delivers product end-to-end

What you bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

  • Experience shipping product directly in a software environment

  • Ability to work fluidly across product thinking, user experience, and hands-on delivery

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and turning open-ended problems into practical next steps

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills in a remote-first, pod-based environment

  • Curiosity about users, fast learning loops, and a bias toward improving the product through iteration

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping product in a software context, not only coordinating roadmap or requirements

  • Strong AI-native delivery habits: able to use AI tools effectively for first drafts, implementation steps, and iteration, while reviewing and improving weak output rather than accepting it

  • Ability to describe and shape intended user experience clearly, including flow, hierarchy, states, copy, and accessibility expectations

  • Strong product and customer judgment: able to understand the user problem behind a request, use lightweight evidence and customer feedback, and make pragmatic decisions that create broader product value

  • Sound technical judgment within an established architecture, including the ability to test what was built, trace issues, understand frontend/backend boundaries, and contribute beyond a pure frontend scope over time

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with workflow software, orchestration, admin/platform tooling, or similarly technical product surfaces

  • Experience working in small, high-autonomy pods with broad ownership across discovery, design, and delivery

  • Familiarity with enterprise governance concerns: identity and access management, RBAC and permission models, multi-tenancy, audit logging, or compliance-driven requirements

  • Experience designing for administrator and platform-operator personas

  • Ability to capture validation learnings clearly, distinguish signal from noise, and help improve lightweight product validation practices

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Who we are: Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products. Our culture: We have hubs in the Bay Area, NYC, Austin, Toronto, and São Paulo. However, we maintain a remote-first work culture. #WorkFromAnywhere We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation. We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule. Location: Remote - Germany From Home / Beach / Mountain / Cafe / Anywhere! We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed team. You can find your productive zone and work from there. About the Role: As a DevOps Engineer at Sardine, you'll play a critical role in evolving our infrastructure and platform tooling to support a growing engineering team. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you’ll drive key initiatives across deployment, observability, developer productivity, and cloud cost management. You’ll work closely with application engineers, QA, and cross-functional stakeholders like Security and Finance to ensure our systems are reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient. The role involves building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, improving system observability, optimizing cloud usage through FinOps governance, and strengthening our platform’s resilience. While we have core tools in place, we’re looking for someone who can both own and elevate them by identifying gaps, improving automation, and proactively driving improvements. This is an ideal role for someone who brings deep technical expertise, thrives in high-ownership environments, and is excited to shape the future of DevOps. What you'll be doing: Own and evolve our DevOps and platform engineering function, from build and deployment pipelines to monitoring, infrastructure as code, and cost optimization. Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines that are secure, scalable, and built to support rapid product iterations without sacrificing stability. Improve observability via Datadog, GCP, and custom dashboards, including FinOps focused observability outcomes. Implement and maintain FinOps governance, including showback and chargeback models, to drive cost accountability across engineering teams. Enable developer productivity by creating internal tooling, reusable modules, and simplifying infrastructure for other engineering teams. Help teams define and measure SLOs setting the standard for how we think about system health and reliability. Serve as a FinOps thought leader, collaborating with Product and Engineering to define the most cost-effective architectural patterns for new services and features. Play a key role in shaping our engineering culture, DevOps best practices, and influencing our long-term DevOps roadmap. Work cross-functionally with product engineering, security, finance, and other teams to align technical spending with business unit economics and financial goals. What you'll need: 6+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or software engineering roles, ideally in high-growth startup environments Proficiency in Python or Go, with strong software engineering fundamentals Proven ownership of production infrastructure and platform tooling, with strong debugging skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex distributed systems and diagnose unforeseen financial spikes Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing highly secure and robust infrastructure, particularly in environments with stringent regulatory requirements such as those used by government agencies and major financial institutions Deep experience with Kubernetes and tools like ArgoCD, Helm, and Terraform Familiarity with GCP (preferred) or other major cloud providers, with a deep focus on cloud cost management, leveraging reserved instances/savings plans, and implementing cost anomaly detection Hands-on experience with dedicated FinOps tooling (e.g., Kubecost, AWS Cost Explorer, GCP Cloud Billing, DoIT Cloud Intelligence) or building custom tooling for cost allocation and reporting. Strong experience building CI/CD pipelines and internal developer tooling from the ground up Hands-on experience with observability tools like Prometheus or Datadog, and participation in an on-call rotation Benefits we offer: Generous compensation in cash and equity Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture Flexible paid time off and Year-end break Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific MacBook Pro delivered to your door One-time stipend to set up a home office — desk, chair, screen, etc. Monthly meal stipend Monthly social meet-up stipend Annual health and wellness stipend Annual Learning stipend Join a fast-growing company with world-class professionals from around the world. If you are seeking a meaningful career, you found the right place, and we would love to hear from you. title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager
description: Company Overview Mindpeak is a Hamburg-based AI company on a mission to make cancer diagnosis more accurate, efficient and personalized. We build deep-learning solutions for computational pathology that bring AI directly into clinical practice. Our technology is already used in routine diagnostics across more than 25 countries and supports leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies in developing and advancing new cancer treatments. What makes Mindpeak special is the combination of disciplines required to make this work. Software engineers and machine learning experts work alongside pathologists, scientists, product specialists and commercial teams to turn cutting-edge AI into products that deliver real value in healthcare. This also makes building our team unusually interesting. Many of the people we hire sit at the intersection of different disciplines and are difficult to find through conventional recruiting. Identifying exceptional talent, understanding what great looks like and building hiring processes that allow us to make consistently strong decisions are therefore critical to Mindpeak’s next stage of growth. The Role We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Manager to take ownership of recruiting across Mindpeak. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who genuinely enjoys recruiting and sees Talent Acquisition itself as their profession. You will recruit across different functions, with a particular focus on senior, business-critical and hard-to-fill roles spanning Product, Technology and Business. You will work closely with our founders and hiring managers to define what we actually need, identify what great looks like for each role and translate this into rigorous, efficient hiring processes. This is a hands-on recruiting role, not a generalist People & Culture or Organizational Development position. You will personally run critical searches, source candidates, conduct interviews and close hires. At the same time, we expect you to help raise the quality of hiring across Mindpeak by challenging unclear requirements, improving interview practices and bringing structure and discipline to how we make hiring decisions. You will not inherit a recruiting team, but you will have the mandate and budget to work with external recruiters and specialist search partners where they add value. Your Mission Own the full recruiting cycle : from search strategy, sourcing and screening through interviews, offers and closing. Partner with our CEO and hiring managers as a trusted talent advisor : clarify requirements, challenge assumptionsand drive decisions forward. Proactively identify and engage high-quality candidates , particularly for senior, leadership and hard-to-fill roles. Run high-quality interviews that go beyond CVs and polished answers, uncovering concrete evidence of impact, decision-making and individual contribution. Select, brief and actively manage external recruiters and search partners where they add value. Keep pipelines, bottlenecks and risks transparent for leadership, and keep improving how Mindpeak hires without unnecessary bureaucracy. What Success Looks Like Priority searches run with clear role profiles and explicit assessment criteria, even when requirements start out ambiguous. You successfully engage high-quality passive candidates and build genuine interest in Mindpeak and our roles. Interviews across Mindpeak become more rigorous and consistent , based on evidence rather than titles or impressions. Most importantly, critical roles get closed with people who raise the quality of the organisation. Your Experience Substantial hands-on experience owning full-cycle recruiting; a background in executive search or another environment with a strong sourcing and assessment culture is a plus. Proven track record of closing senior, leadership and hard-to-fill searches , with strong active sourcing skills and confidence approaching passive candidates. Experience in a technology-driven, high-growth environment , recruiting across functions such as Product, Technology and Business. You don't need to be technical, but you understand how these teams work well enough to recruit credibly. Experience working directly with founders or demanding senior hiring managers and influencing their decisions rather than simply executing requirements. Experience translating unclear business needs into clear role profiles, scorecards and structured interview processes. Experience selecting and managing external agencies or headhunters . Fluent English ; German is an advantage but not essential. Your Profile You interview for evidence and have strong talent judgment. You can tell an impressive CV or polished answer from real evidence that someone will succeed. You know what good looks like and can credibly bring that standard into an organisation still developing its own. You challenge senior stakeholders constructively and communicate clearly and directly with executives, hiring managers and senior candidates alike. You take ownership. When a search isn't working, you diagnose why and change the approach, and you know when requirements need to change. You create structure without bureaucracy , just enough process to improve speed, quality and accountability. You learn quickly and immerse yourself in unfamiliar domains until you can recruit credibly in them. Why Mindpeak Take real ownership of Talent Acquisition in a growing AI company where hiring exceptional people has a direct impact on the success of the business. Recruit across some of the most interesting talent markets today – from AI and software engineering to medicine, science and commercial roles. Work directly with our founders and senior leaders Shape and continuously improve how we identify, assess and hire exceptional people rather than simply executing a fixed corporate recruiting process. See the impact of the teams you build on cancer diagnostics and treatment. Work from our centrally located Hamburg office with a beautiful view over the harbor. Application Details Please send us: Your CV and reference letters Your salary expectations Your earliest possible starting date Note: Direct applicants only. We do not work with recruiting agencies for this position. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Werkstudent im Bereich Legal / Compliance (d/m/w)
description: Ihre Aufgaben Bei NYALA begleitest Du die Weiterentwicklung unseres Angebots von juristischer Seite. Du lernst, regulatorische Anforderungen umzusetzen sowie zu diesen mit den Aufsichtsbehörden zu kommunizieren. Dabei wendest Du den bestehenden Rechtsrahmen aus eWpG, eWpRV, KWG und GwG an, entwickelst unsere Produkte in diesem weiter, begleitest mit uns aktuelle Entwicklungen bei der Gesetzgebung und nimmst über Stellungnahmen und Konsultationen aktiv Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung der Gesetzgebung zur Blockchain-Technologie. Du hast damit nicht nur die Möglichkeit, die geltenden Regelungen auf konkrete Sachverhalte im Unternehmen anzuwenden (und das anders als in der Kanzlei umfassend und gestaltend, nicht nur im Rahmen eines beschränkten Beratungsauftrags), sondern auch zukünftige Entwicklungen aktiv mitzugestalten. Im operativen Tagesgeschäft arbeitest du direkt dem Geldwäsche-, Compliance- und Risikobeauftragten zu, bereitest Sachverhalte entscheidungsreif auf und hältst Fristen, Maßnahmen und Wiedervorlagen nach. Im Schwerpunkt des Berichtswesens erstellst du Vorlagen für die Berichte an Funktionsträger im Unternehmen, pflegst Kennzahlen und Auswertungen, hältst Richtlinien, Handbücher und Arbeitsanweisungen aktuell und unterstützt bei Jahresabschluss- und Sonderprüfungen. Ihr Profil Du brennst für Technologie und speziell DLT, glaubst an die revolutionäre Chance der Blockchain im Finanzsystem und hast Interesse an kapitalmarktrechtlichen Fragestellungen. Vollständige Vorkenntnisse in eWpG, GwG und KWG erwarten wir nicht; ein großer Teil dieses Rechtsrahmens ist selbst erst wenige Jahre alt und entwickelt sich beständig weiter. Wir erwarten Sorgfalt im Detail, Verbindlichkeit bei Fristen, die Fähigkeit, komplizierte Sachverhalte knapp und nachvollziehbar zu verschriftlichen, und Diskretion im Umgang mit Kunden- und Unternehmensdaten. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch ist für Aufsichtskorrespondenz und im Meldewesen erforderlich, Englisch für Korrespondenz mit internationalen Kunden und für die Interpretation von Rechtstexten von Vorteil. Warum wir? title: Product Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Warum LPE Immobilien? Die Hausverwaltung ist der unterschätzteste Beruf Deutschlands: Kein anderer entscheidet so unmittelbar darüber, wie Menschen wohnen. Trotzdem gilt der Hausverwalter bis heute als Buchhalter mit Schlüsselbund. Wir wollen das ändern, und Software ist dafür einer unserer zentralen Hebel. Mit lpeOS bauen wir die Systeme, mit denen wir selbst jeden Tag arbeiten: das Kundenportal für unsere Eigentümer, KI-Agenten, die eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen, und das Verwaltercockpit als Arbeitsumgebung unserer Verwalter. Wir digitalisieren unsere eigenen Prozesse, um die Arbeit unserer Verwalter jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu machen, mit dem Anspruch, die Branche zu revolutionieren. Kaum eine Branche wurde von moderner Software so lange übersehen. Der Abstand zwischen dem, was ist, und dem, was möglich ist, ist riesig, und wir bauen ihn Stück für Stück zu. Du wärst eine der ersten Personen im Produktteam. Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst Fullstack in TypeScript , vom Kundenportal über das Verwaltercockpit bis zu den Services und der Infrastruktur dahinter, auf der grünen Wiese und ohne Altlasten. Features verantwortest du end-to-end: von der Idee über die Gestaltung bis zum Release, bei Bedarf auch ohne Designer an deiner Seite. Du baust KI-Agenten als Produktfunktionalität für unsere Verwalter und Kunden. Zugleich entwickeln wir unsere eigene Entwicklungsumgebung permanent weiter: ein modernes Setup rund um Cursor und Claude Code, inklusive Agent-Graph-Loops und Harness. Dabei arbeitest du nah an den Nutzern : Deine Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden sind direkt erreichbar, Feedback bekommst du auf kurzem und direktem Weg. Wir sammeln Probleme, bewerten sie und bauen die wichtigsten in festen Cycles. Unser Stack : TypeScript durchgehend, mit React und Next.js im Frontend und Node im Backend, als Monorepo auf Google Cloud (Infrastructure as Code), dazu Postgres und event-getriebene Prozesse. Du musst nicht alles davon kennen, den Rest lernst du bei uns. Was du mitbringen solltest 2 bis 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der Webentwicklung. raw.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Golang
raw.description:
About the team:

The Commercial Systems and Intelligence squad is a newly formed team within SumUp's Acquisition Mission under the Run & Grow tribe. We sit at the intersection of data, backend engineering, and sales operations, building the infrastructure that powers how SumUp attributes merchant acquisition, calculates commissions, and understands the full lifecycle of every merchant.

Today, these processes are largely manual. We're here to change that, automating what's opaque, and building systems that sales representatives, leadership, and analysts can actually trust. You'll join at the very beginning, helping to shape how the squad works, the architecture it builds on, and the standards it holds itself to.

 

What you'll do:

  • Aggregating data from across the SumUp ecosystem to determine which acquisition channel or sales agent drove a merchant to take a valuable action (e.g. signing up, adopting a product)
  • Establishing data models, API contracts, and rule definitions that automate existing manual commission workflows for field and tele-sales agents, partnerships and merchant referrals
  • Build the Lifecycle Event Log in close collaboration with the Merchant Intelligence squad. A centralized store of curated merchant lifecycle events (signups, product usage, verification, purchases) used across attribution, recommendations, customer support and sales
  • Build internal backoffices and APIs for sales representatives and leaders to monitor commission and modify commission plans, manage portfolios and resolve disputes
  • Define and document API contracts, schemas, and integration patterns that other engineering teams can adopt confidently
  • Establish best practices for testing, observability, and incident response within a newly formed squad
  • Use AI and agentic coding tools deliberately, to scaffold services, write tests, explore unfamiliar code, and draft documentation while maintaining full accountability for what gets shipped

 

You'll be great for this role if you:

  • Bring a strong backend engineering background in Go, or are a typed-language generalist ready to ramp up quickly
  • Have designed APIs and distributed systems with clear contracts, versioning, and integration patterns
  • Are fluent in relational and analytical databases (PostgreSQL, Snowflake) and comfortable making the right choice for the right use case
  • Have built Kafka-based, event-driven systems and understand event sourcing and CDC patterns
  • Have experience in auditable, high-trust systems where every decision must be traceable — fintech, payments, or similar domains
  • Have built services from scratch in greenfield, early-stage squads with limited prior context,  and are energized, not unsettled, by that challenge
  • Have experience with testing, observability, and incident response practices and treat them as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts
  • Are resourceful and adaptable, you take end-to-end ownership, do more with less, and adjust quickly as priorities shift
  • Can bridge technical and non-technical audiences, translating fuzzy problems into clear engineering work and explaining trade-offs to engineers and sales stakeholders alike
  • Are pragmatic, you know when good enough ships value and when something genuinely needs to be done properly
  • Have mentorship instincts, you raise the bar for the people around you, not just your own output

 

Why you should join SumUp:

🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🧑‍🔬 We take learning and experimentation seriously with Hack Days every second Friday, and entire global Hack Weeks.

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2,000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP program: You will own a stake in SumUp's future success

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🔄 30 Days Sabbatical: Enjoy the unique opportunity to take a well-deserved break with our 30 days sabbatical benefit after completing 3 years of employment with SumUp

🔗 Referral Bonus: Earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, relocation assistance, subsidised office lunches

raw.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Golang
raw.description:
About the team:

The Commercial Systems and Intelligence squad is a newly formed team within SumUp's Acquisition Mission under the Run & Grow tribe. We sit at the intersection of data, backend engineering, and sales operations, building the infrastructure that powers how SumUp attributes merchant acquisition, calculates commissions, and understands the full lifecycle of every merchant.

Today, these processes are largely manual. We're here to change that, automating what's opaque, and building systems that sales representatives, leadership, and analysts can actually trust. You'll join at the very beginning, helping to shape how the squad works, the architecture it builds on, and the standards it holds itself to.

 

What you'll do:

  • Aggregating data from across the SumUp ecosystem to determine which acquisition channel or sales agent drove a merchant to take a valuable action (e.g. signing up, adopting a product)
  • Establishing data models, API contracts, and rule definitions that automate existing manual commission workflows for field and tele-sales agents, partnerships and merchant referrals
  • Build the Lifecycle Event Log in close collaboration with the Merchant Intelligence squad. A centralized store of curated merchant lifecycle events (signups, product usage, verification, purchases) used across attribution, recommendations, customer support and sales
  • Build internal backoffices and APIs for sales representatives and leaders to monitor commission and modify commission plans, manage portfolios and resolve disputes
  • Define and document API contracts, schemas, and integration patterns that other engineering teams can adopt confidently
  • Establish best practices for testing, observability, and incident response within a newly formed squad
  • Use AI and agentic coding tools deliberately, to scaffold services, write tests, explore unfamiliar code, and draft documentation while maintaining full accountability for what gets shipped

 

You'll be great for this role if you:

  • Bring a strong backend engineering background in Go, or are a typed-language generalist ready to ramp up quickly
  • Have designed APIs and distributed systems with clear contracts, versioning, and integration patterns
  • Are fluent in relational and analytical databases (PostgreSQL, Snowflake) and comfortable making the right choice for the right use case
  • Have built Kafka-based, event-driven systems and understand event sourcing and CDC patterns
  • Have experience in auditable, high-trust systems where every decision must be traceable — fintech, payments, or similar domains
  • Have built services from scratch in greenfield, early-stage squads with limited prior context,  and are energized, not unsettled, by that challenge
  • Have experience with testing, observability, and incident response practices and treat them as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts
  • Are resourceful and adaptable, you take end-to-end ownership, do more with less, and adjust quickly as priorities shift
  • Can bridge technical and non-technical audiences, translating fuzzy problems into clear engineering work and explaining trade-offs to engineers and sales stakeholders alike
  • Are pragmatic, you know when good enough ships value and when something genuinely needs to be done properly
  • Have mentorship instincts, you raise the bar for the people around you, not just your own output

 

Why you should join SumUp:

🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🧑‍🔬 We take learning and experimentation seriously with Hack Days every second Friday, and entire global Hack Weeks.

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2,000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP program: You will own a stake in SumUp's future success

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🔄 30 Days Sabbatical: Enjoy the unique opportunity to take a well-deserved break with our 30 days sabbatical benefit after completing 3 years of employment with SumUp

🔗 Referral Bonus: Earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

raw.description:
About the team:

What you'll do:

  • Aggregating data from across the SumUp ecosystem to determine which acquisition channel or sales agent drove a merchant to take a valuable action (e.g. signing up, adopting a product)
  • Establishing data models, API contracts, and rule definitions that automate existing manual commission workflows for field and tele-sales agents, partnerships and merchant referrals
  • Build the Lifecycle Event Log in close collaboration with the Merchant Intelligence squad. A centralized store of curated merchant lifecycle events (signups, product usage, verification, purchases) used across attribution, recommendations, customer support and sales
  • Build internal backoffices and APIs for sales representatives and leaders to monitor commission and modify commission plans, manage portfolios and resolve disputes
  • Define and document API contracts, schemas, and integration patterns that other engineering teams can adopt confidently
  • Establish best practices for testing, observability, and incident response within a newly formed squad
  • Use AI and agentic coding tools deliberately, to scaffold services, write tests, explore unfamiliar code, and draft documentation while maintaining full accountability for what gets shipped

 

You'll be great for this role if you:

  • Bring a strong backend engineering background in Go, or are a typed-language generalist ready to ramp up quickly
  • Have designed APIs and distributed systems with clear contracts, versioning, and integration patterns
  • Are fluent in relational and analytical databases (PostgreSQL, Snowflake) and comfortable making the right choice for the right use case

title: Operations Manager (m/w/d) | Coaching & Organisation
description: Du bist der Mensch, bei dem am Ende einfach alles läuft . Du liebst Struktur, behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Aufgaben den Überblick und willst einen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich, auf den sich Kunden und Kollegen zu 100 % verlassen können. Dann könnte das hier ziemlich gut zu dir passen. RWKMP® ist eine etablierte Unternehmensberatung aus Münster. Wir begleiten jedes Jahr mehrere hundert Verkäufer und Führungskräfte aus der Automobilbranche in unseren zwölfmonatigen Coachingprogrammen – mit Kunden in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz. Damit diese Programme funktionieren, braucht es hinter den Kulissen perfekte Organisation: Teilnehmer, Termine, Zugänge, Unterlagen, Kommunikation und Live-Trainings müssen zuverlässig ineinandergreifen. Genau dafür suchen wir dich. Dabei arbeitest du nicht mit Zettelwirtschaft und veralteten Systemen. Wir arbeiten digital, nutzen Airtable, Learning Suite, CARvinci, Excel und KI-Tools – und entwickeln unsere Abläufe kontinuierlich weiter. Aufgaben Fünf Bereiche, ein Ziel: Unsere Kunden sollen merken, dass bei uns alles organisiert ist. Kunden & Teilnehmer sauber onboarden – Ein Autohaus startet mit unserem Coaching. Ab diesem Moment sorgst du dafür, dass organisatorisch alles steht: Teilnehmer anlegen, Gruppen zuordnen, Termine verschicken, WhatsApp-Gruppen vorbereiten sowie Zugänge zu Learning Suite, CARvinci und Persönlichkeitsanalysen koordinieren. Der Kunde soll nicht hinter Informationen herlaufen müssen. Zwölf Monate Coaching im Blick behalten – Unsere Programme laufen über ein Jahr. Teilnehmer wechseln, Termine stehen an, Informationen müssen raus und Unterlagen rechtzeitig bereitliegen. Du behältst Gruppen, Termine, Zugänge, Teilnehmerwechsel, Zertifikate und offene Punkte im Blick – und sorgst dafür, dass nichts verloren geht. Prozesse zuverlässig ausführen und verbessern – Du arbeitest nach bestehenden Abläufen, dokumentierst sauber und stellst sicher, dass Prozesse zuverlässig eingehalten werden. Gleichzeitig sollst du mitdenken: Wo entsteht unnötige Handarbeit? Wo passieren Fehler? Was können wir einfacher oder digitaler lösen? Du arbeitest unter anderem mit Airtable, Excel, Learning Suite, ChatGPT und weiteren digitalen Tools . Live-Trainings vorbereiten – In Münster organisierst du gemeinsam mit dem Team unsere Live-Coachings: Teilnehmerlisten, Namensschilder, Unterlagen, Analysen, Raum und Technik. Und du packst selbst mit an. Du kennst unsere Kunden dadurch nicht nur aus einer Datenbank, sondern siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit möglich macht. Digitalisierung mitlernen und mitgestalten – Du musst heute kein Automatisierungs- oder KI-Profi sein. Aber du solltest Lust darauf haben, neue Tools kennenzulernen und gemeinsam mit uns zu überlegen, wie Prozesse noch besser funktionieren können. Wenn du irgendwann selbst einfache Automatisierungen baust oder Abläufe digital weiterentwickelst: umso besser. Du musst weder verkaufen noch selbst Coachings geben. – Dein Schwerpunkt ist klar: Du hältst unsere Coachingorganisation zuverlässig zusammen. Wenn du sagst, dass etwas erledigt ist, möchten wir uns darauf verlassen können, dass es erledigt ist. Du musst weder verkaufen noch selbst Coachings geben. Dein Schwerpunkt ist klar: Du hältst unsere Coachingorganisation zuverlässig zusammen. Wenn du sagst, dass etwas erledigt ist, möchten wir uns darauf verlassen können, dass es erledigt ist. Deine Perspektive Ein Verantwortungsbereich, der mit dir wachsen kann. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Coachingteam sowie den Verantwortlichen für Sales und Geschäftsführung zusammen. Am Anfang lernst du unsere Abläufe kennen und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt die Verantwortung dafür. Danach kannst du dich fachlich weiterentwickeln: mehr Prozessverantwortung, eigene Projekte, stärkere Digitalisierung oder zusätzliche Verantwortung innerhalb unserer Operations. Du musst bei uns nicht Führungskraft werden, um dich weiterzuentwickeln. Wenn du richtig gut in deinem Bereich bist, bekommst du den Raum, ihn immer stärker selbst zu gestalten. Qualifikation Wenn andere sagen „Gib es ihr oder ihm – dann läuft es“, sollten wir uns kennenlernen. Außergewöhnliche Struktur – Du behältst mehrere Programme, Teilnehmer, Termine und offene Punkte gleichzeitig im Blick und verlässt dich dabei nicht nur auf dein Gedächtnis. **Zuverlässigkeit & Prozessdisziplin** – Du arbeitest sorgfältig, hältst Zusagen nach und prüfst, ob Dinge wirklich abgeschlossen sind. Fehler versuchst du zu erkennen, bevor sie beim Kunden ankommen. **Excel & digitale Affinität** – Excel oder Google Sheets gehören für dich zum normalen Arbeitsalltag. In neue Software arbeitest du dich schnell ein und hast Lust, moderne Tools und KI für deine Arbeit zu nutzen. Eigenverantwortung & Kommunikation – Du kannst selbstständig arbeiten, Fragen professionell mit Kunden und Kollegen klären und meldest dich frühzeitig, wenn irgendwo etwas nicht funktioniert – idealerweise direkt mit einem Lösungsvorschlag. Eine kaufmännische Ausbildung, beispielsweise im Büromanagement, in der Industrie oder im Autohaus, passt sehr gut. Auch Erfahrung aus Assistenz, Projektorganisation, Kundenbetreuung, Eventorganisation oder Sachbearbeitung kann hervorragend passen. Entscheidend ist nicht dein bisheriger Jobtitel. Entscheidend ist, wie du arbeitest. Automobilwissen brauchst du zum Einstieg nicht. Benefits 3.500–5.000 € brutto. Und ein Umfeld, in dem gute Organisation geschätzt wird. Langfristige und sichere Position – Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle in einer etablierten, profitablen Unternehmensberatung. Wir suchen niemanden für ein sechsmonatiges Projekt, sondern jemanden, der langfristig Verantwortung übernimmt. Weiterbildung & Digitalisierung – Excel, Prozesse, Projektorganisation, KI oder persönliche Entwicklung: Wenn eine Weiterbildung dich in deiner Arbeit besser macht, unterstützen wir dich dabei – ohne starres Mini-Budget. Ausstattung, die zu deiner Arbeit passt – MacBook oder Windows-Laptop, Firmenhandy, moderne Software, klimatisiertes Büro und höhenverstellbare Schreibtische. Dazu Firmenfitness, PrepMyMeal und Getränke. Zeit außerhalb des Jobs – 30 Tage Urlaub plus Geburtstag frei, 1–2 Tage Homeoffice nach Abstimmung. Unsere Coachings finden überwiegend in Münster statt – regelmäßige deutschlandweite Reisen und Hotelübernachtungen gehören nicht zum Alltag. Dein Einstiegsgehalt innerhalb der Spanne richtet sich nach deiner Erfahrung und danach, welche Verantwortung du bereits eigenständig übernehmen kannst. Wenn Struktur deine Stärke ist und du gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, möchten wir dich kennenlernen. Sascha Röwekamp Gründer von RWKMP® Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

  • **Excel & digitale Affinität** – Excel oder Google Sheets gehören für dich zum normalen Arbeitsalltag. In neue Software arbeitest du dich schnell ein und hast Lust, moderne Tools und KI für deine Arbeit zu nutzen.
  • Eigenverantwortung & Kommunikation – Du kannst selbstständig arbeiten, Fragen professionell mit Kunden und Kollegen klären und meldest dich frühzeitig, wenn irgendwo etwas nicht funktioniert – idealerweise direkt mit einem Lösungsvorschlag.

Eine kaufmännische Ausbildung, beispielsweise im Büromanagement, in der Industrie oder im Autohaus, passt sehr gut. Auch Erfahrung aus Assistenz, Projektorganisation, Kundenbetreuung, Eventorganisation oder Sachbearbeitung kann hervorragend passen.

Entscheidend ist nicht dein bisheriger Jobtitel. Entscheidend ist, wie du arbeitest.

Automobilwissen brauchst du zum Einstieg nicht.

Benefits

3.500–5.000 € brutto. Und ein Umfeld, in dem gute Organisation geschätzt wird.

  • Langfristige und sichere Position – Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle in einer etablierten, profitablen Unternehmensberatung. Wir suchen niemanden für ein sechsmonatiges Projekt, sondern jemanden, der langfristig Verantwortung übernimmt.
  • Weiterbildung & Digitalisierung – Excel, Prozesse, Projektorganisation, KI oder persönliche Entwicklung: Wenn eine Weiterbildung dich in deiner Arbeit besser macht, unterstützen wir dich dabei – ohne starres Mini-Budget.
  • Ausstattung, die zu deiner Arbeit passt – MacBook oder Windows-Laptop, Firmenhandy, moderne Software, klimatisiertes Büro und höhenverstellbare Schreibtische. Dazu Firmenfitness, PrepMyMeal und Getränke.
  • Zeit außerhalb des Jobs – 30 Tage Urlaub plus Geburtstag frei, 1–2 Tage Homeoffice nach Abstimmung. Unsere Coachings finden überwiegend in Münster statt – regelmäßige deutschlandweite Reisen und Hotelübernachtungen gehören nicht zum Alltag.

Dein Einstiegsgehalt innerhalb der Spanne richtet sich nach deiner Erfahrung und danach, welche Verantwortung du bereits eigenständig übernehmen kannst.

Wenn Struktur deine Stärke ist und du gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

Sascha Röwekamp
Gründer von RWKMP®

We operate in a huge, fragmented and still highly inefficient market. Our ambition is to make it dramatically easier to access the right inventory, compare opportunities, transact and fulfil container purchases across sellers and locations globally. To win, we need to get a few things exceptionally right: more of the right containers, in the right locations, at better prices — from sellers who are fast, reliable and easy to trade with. That is where you come in. 🧭 The Role As Product Engineer – Procurement , you will own our Procurement function end-to-end in close collaboration with our CEO Christian . This is a hands-on commercial builder role: you run Procurement, improve the economics, and build the processes, automations and product solutions that make the function scale. You will start hands-on: run day-to-day procurement, work directly with sellers, negotiate prices and promotions, support Sales on supply opportunities and understand where our current processes work well — and where they break. But your mandate goes further: Build a Procurement function that becomes a competitive advantage for xChange. We want you to constantly ask: How can we improve the economics? How can we make this process faster? What can we standardize? What can we automate? You will use Claude and other tools to build lightweight solutions yourself, experiment with deterministic and agentic automation, and work closely with Engineering where solutions need to become part of our core product. Over time, repetitive operational work should decrease while your focus on Seller Performance, Procurement strategy, automation and product improvements grows. 📍 Location This is a position based in Hamburg , where you will work closely with our Sales, Product and Engineering team as well as directly with our CEO Christian . Requirements 🚀 Your Impact Ultimately, your work should help xChange transact more containers at better margins , while allowing Procurement to scale without scaling manual work at the same rate. You will: Own and run day-to-day Procurement and tactical Seller Management , using what you learn from operating the processes yourself to continuously improve, streamline and automate the function. Improve our buying economics and Seller Performance by identifying pricing opportunities, negotiating with sellers, driving promotions and improving listing quality, reply speed, release speed and reliability. Use Claude and other tools as part of your day-to-day work to solve problems faster and improve our processes and systems. Build lightweight, bootstrapped solutions yourself when they can solve an immediate problem — from deterministic workflows to agentic solutions. Work closely with Engineering when those solutions need to become more robust, scalable or part of our core product. Build a more systematic, data-driven view of Procurement , so we can identify and prioritize the biggest opportunities across our seller portfolio. Drive larger strategic initiatives such as gatebuy, future pickups and new ways of sourcing inventory that help us build a structurally better trading engine. 🌟 What Makes You a Great Fit? We are looking for someone who combines commercial intuition, strong execution and a product/automation mindset . You are likely a great fit if you: Get genuine satisfaction from negotiating a better deal and spotting commercial opportunities others might miss. Have a passion for trading, pricing and markets — whether that comes from work, the stock market, sports betting or simply how you think. Are commercially confident enough to own seller relationships, make decisions independently and push back when needed . Perform well under pressure and at speed — matching the pace of Sales without sacrificing accuracy. Are highly structured and operationally reliable: fast without becoming sloppy . Enjoy getting your hands dirty and executing the work yourself. Think beyond individual cases and naturally ask how a process can be improved at a system level . Can balance short-term execution with long-term improvement — improving processes, automation and scalability over time. Are data-driven and comfortable using metrics to identify opportunities. Already use AI to solve real-world problems and are excited about building prototypes, workflows and automations. Can translate a business problem into something Engineering can work with. Have strong ownership, drive and the learning velocity to grow further into product and automation . You do not need to be a software engineer . We care much more about your ability to understand a problem deeply, imagine a better solution, prototype where possible and collaborate effectively with Engineers. Deep container knowledge and traditional Procurement experience are also not prerequisites . This role might not be for you if… You prefer having perfect information before making decisions — this role requires fast judgment under uncertainty . You don’t enjoy working in a high-pressure, fast-moving commercial environment where Procurement needs to match the pace of Sales. You prefer staying at one level of the problem rather than switching between what needs to happen now, what needs to change commercially, and what needs to improve in the process or product . You prefer clearly bounded responsibilities over end-to-end ownership — we expect you to take decisions, push back on sellers when needed, and stay accountable until the issue is actually resolved. 👀 What to Expect A rare combination of commercial and product ownership: You will understand and improve the full Procurement system — from the economics of individual trades to the processes and technology behind the function. A role that evolves with you: You will initially spend significant time running Procurement hands-on. As you improve and automate the function, your role should increasingly shift toward Seller Performance, Procurement economics, product and automation. Direct exposure to the business: You will work closely with our CEO Christian and have direct visibility into how supply, pricing and seller performance translate into containers transacted and margin. Build rather than inherit: You are not joining a mature Procurement function with a fixed playbook. You will help define how Procurement at xChange should work in the future, from how we manage sellers today to how much of the function can eventually be automated. AI as a real working tool: We expect you to use tools such as Claude to increase your own leverage and continuously challenge which parts of your job still need to be done manually. That is where you come in.

🧭 The Role

As Product Engineer – Procurement, you will own our Procurement function end-to-end in close collaboration with our CEO Christian.

This is a hands-on commercial builder role: you run Procurement, improve the economics, and build the processes, automations and product solutions that make the function scale.

You will start hands-on: run day-to-day procurement, work directly with sellers, negotiate prices and promotions, support Sales on supply opportunities and understand where our current processes work well — and where they break.

📍 Location

This is a position based in Hamburg, where you will work closely with our Sales, Product and Engineering team as well as directly with our CEO Christian.

Requirements

🚀 Your Impact

Ultimately, your work should help xChange transact more containers at better margins, while allowing Procurement to scale without scaling manual work at the same rate.

You will:

  • Own and run day-to-day Procurement and tactical Seller Management, using what you learn from operating the processes yourself to continuously improve, streamline and automate the function.
  • Improve our buying economics and Seller Performance by identifying pricing opportunities, negotiating with sellers, driving promotions and improving listing quality, reply speed, release speed and reliability.
  • Use Claude and other tools as part of your day-to-day work to solve problems faster and improve our processes and systems.
  • Build lightweight, bootstrapped solutions yourself when they can solve an immediate problem — from deterministic workflows to agentic solutions.
  • Work closely with Engineering when those solutions need to become more robust, scalable or part of our core product.
  • Build a more systematic, data-driven view of Procurement, so we can identify and prioritize the biggest opportunities across our seller portfolio.
  • Drive larger strategic initiatives such as gatebuy, future pickups and new ways of sourcing inventory that help us build a structurally better trading engine.

🌟 What Makes You a Great Fit?

We are looking for someone who combines commercial intuition, strong execution and a product/automation mindset.

You are likely a great fit if you:

  • Get genuine satisfaction from negotiating a better deal and spotting commercial opportunities others might miss.
  • Have a passion for trading, pricing and markets — whether that comes from work, the stock market, sports betting or simply how you think.

  • Enjoy getting your hands dirty and executing the work yourself.
  • Think beyond individual cases and naturally ask how a process can be improved at a system level.
  • Can balance short-term execution with long-term improvement — improving processes, automation and scalability over time.

  • Already use AI to solve real-world problems and are excited about building prototypes, workflows and automations.

title: Senior Backend-Entwickler – Agents (100% Remote in Deutschland)
description: Wir suchen Senior Developer, die in unserem vollständig remoten Team an unseren Agenten arbeiten. Wenn du Komplexität magst und willst, dass deine Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegt, passt du zu uns. Über uns Hausverwalter.ai ist eine All-in-One-Plattform für Hausverwaltungen, mit Funktionen wie Inbox, CRM, Dokumenten, Telefonie, Video Calls, Team Chat und KI-Agenten. Unsere Mission ist es, alles zu automatisieren, was ein Hausverwalter tut. Über die Rolle Unsere Plattform ist von Tag eins an agentisch gedacht. Bevor wir überhaupt die UI geplant haben, haben wir geplant, wie Agenten mit der Software arbeiten. Denk dran – unser Ziel ist, die ganze Branche zu automatisieren, und das meinen wir ernst. Heute gibt es für fast alles, was der Nutzer in der UI machen kann, ein Agenten-Tool, und der Co-Pilot (der tägliche Assistent des Nutzers) kann alles für ihn übernehmen, sogar den Dark Mode an- und ausschalten. Aber der Co-Pilot ist erst der Anfang. Die eigentliche Herausforderung sind die autonomen Agenten. Dazu unten mehr. Woran du arbeiten wirst Inbox-Agents: Autonome Agenten, die anspringen, sobald in einem Ticket etwas Neues passiert. Kunden trainieren sie selbst ODER nehmen einfach eine der Vorlagen, die du für sie baust. Diese Agenten können heute schon komplette komplexe Abläufe allein übernehmen und sind einer der Hauptgründe, warum sich Kunden für unsere Software interessieren. Aber wann sollte ein Agent an einen Menschen abgeben, statt selbst zu Ende zu machen? Wie stellen wir sicher, dass er sich an den Prozess hält? Das sind deine Fragen. Harness Engineering: Der Agent hat über 100 Tools. Aber er muss eine Anfrage so verstehen, wie ein Hausverwalter sie versteht, und nicht so, wie die Begriffe außerhalb der Branche klingen. Was gehört in den System Prompt, was in Skills? Knowledge Base: Unsere Plattform hat eine eigene Knowledge Base, ähnlich wie Notion. Komplett selbst gebaut und gedacht als kollektives Gehirn des Unternehmens. Aber sollte die KI auch von selbst „lernen"? Und wenn ja, wann? Und wie machen wir die Suche in der Knowledge Base besser — über bessere Tools, System Prompts oder Skills? Voice-Agents: Dieselben Agenten, nur am Telefon — auf LiveKit gebaut, die Anrufe genauso abwickeln wie unsere Text-Agenten Tickets. LLM Infrastructure. Das richtige Modell für die jeweilige Aufgabe wählen, per Caching und Streaming die Latenz drücken, bei Provider-Ausfällen sauber neu versuchen, Context kompakt halten, die RAG-Suche optimieren, Usage über alle Provider tracken, Kosten senken und mit Evals prüfen, was wirklich besser ist. Unser minimalistischer Tech Stack Alles ist TypeScript. Vom Datenbankschema bis ins Frontend. Backend: Convex (Datenbank & Serverless Functions) Frontend: Next.js , React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui Technologien, die dir begegnen werden: Vercel AI SDK, Convex Agent Component Gehalt 5000 – 6000 Euro brutto, mit Raum für Wachstum und Beförderungen in den kommenden Monaten und Jahren Benefits 100 % remote Flexible Arbeitszeiten So viele KI-Tokens, wie du brauchst Wir sind eigenfinanziert und profitabel (und verbrennen kein VC-Geld, um zu überleben) Kleines Team, echte Verantwortung — was du baust, geht auch wirklich live Schnelle Entscheidungen, keine sinnlosen Meetings und keine Freigabeschleifen, durch die du dich kämpfen musst Unsere Werte Dinge fertig machen, jeder Tag zählt Transparenz und Ehrlichkeit, gerade wenn es unangenehm wird Nach Großem streben – dich und andere ständig fordern Wenn du genauer sehen willst, was wir bauen: Schau auf unserem YouTube-Kanal vorbei — kleiner Hinweis, der ist auf Deutsch. Du bist fließend in Englisch und Deutsch ein erfahrener Entwickler mit mehr als 2 Jahren Erfahrung im Bauen von Agenten für den Produktivbetrieb AI-native. Du hast agentische Features ausgeliefert, auf die sich echte Nutzer verlassen, und du hast eine Meinung zu Retrieval, Evals, Tool-Design und dazu, wo die heutigen Spitzenmodelle an ihre Grenzen kommen. in erster Linie Builder. Du bringst lieber heute eine grobe v1 raus, als drei Wochen lang die perfekte zu planen. auf dem neuesten Stand bei neuen KI-Modellen und der Forschung jemand, der fast seinen gesamten Code mit KI schreibt es gewohnt, autonom zu arbeiten und volle Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben zu übernehmen unter Leistungsdruck sogar noch besser schnell darin, Neues zu lernen, und siehst dich als Generalist, nicht als Spezialist Dein Techstack : Ist nicht wichtig, da bei uns KI deinen Code schreiben wird. title: IT-Administrator (m/w/d) (m/w/d) in Teilzeit
description: Wir handeln THG-Quoten und betreiben mit Elektrovorteil eine der aktiven B2C-Marken im Markt. Seit 2021haben wir mehrere hunderttausend Prämien an Halter von Elektrofahrzeugen ausgezahlt. Das Team arbeitetverteilt in Deutschland und besteht zum größten Teil aus Vertrieb, Kundensupport und einem kleinenEntwicklungsteam. Eine eigene IT-Administration gab es bei uns bisher nicht. Microsoft 365, HubSpot, Domains und Postfächerhaben Geschäftsführung und Kollegen aus anderen Rollen nebenbei betreut. Das reicht nicht mehr: Das Teamwächst, wir haben viel E-Mail-Verkehr mit Kunden und Partnern, und Kontosicherheit und Zustellbarkeitmüssen zuverlässig funktionieren. Wir suchen deshalb eine Person, die diese Themen übernimmt, aufräumtund dann dauerhaft in Ordnung hält. Wenn du KI nicht als Buzzword, sondern als tägliches Werkzeug nutzt undlieber skriptest als klickst, passt die Rolle. Deine Mission Du machst unsere IT verlässlich und hältst sie ohne Handarbeit in Ordnung: Microsoft 365 und Entra ID sauberadministriert, E-Mail-Zustellbarkeit unter Kontrolle, Zugänge geordnet, und alles, was sich wiederholt, als Skriptoder KI-gestützter Ablauf statt als Checkliste. Aufgaben Aufräumen und dann Betrieb: Am Anfang gehst du Accounts und Lizenzen durch, ordnest Rollen undRechte, schließt verwaiste Postfächer, setzt MFA und Conditional Access lückenlos durch und bringst SPF,DKIM und DMARC für alle Domains in Ordnung. Danach geht es in den laufenden Betrieb. Microsoft 365 und Entra ID: Benutzer, Gruppen, Lizenzen, Rollen und Rechte, Sicherheitsrichtlinien,Geräte. Dazu die Sicherheitsmeldungen aus Defender und Entra ID einordnen, darauf reagieren unddokumentieren. Tenant sauber halten: Freigaben für Drittanwendungen prüfen und bereinigen, Enterprise Apps und App-Berechtigungen auf Postfächer und Daten im Blick behalten. On- und Offboarding mit allen Zugängen (Microsoft, HubSpot, Atlassian, GitHub, KI-Tools und die übrigenSaaS-Dienste), als geskripteter Ablauf statt Checkliste. Domains, DNS und E-Mail: Verwaltung unserer Domains, Mail-Konfiguration, Umzüge und Migrationen vonPostfächern. Zustellbarkeit und Spam-Schutz in beide Richtungen, inklusive Absenderreputation, Blacklist-Monitoring und dem Zusammenspiel mit dem Versand aus HubSpot, Mailchimp, unserer Plattform undeasybill. HubSpot: Nutzer- und Rechteverwaltung und die Anbindung an Microsoft (Anmeldung, Kalender,Postfächer). KI-Werkzeuge verwalten: Team-Accounts und Zugriffe (Claude, GitHub), Konnektoren und MCP-Anbindungen an Microsoft 365, HubSpot und Jira, Regeln für Datenzugriff und Datenschutz. Eigene Arbeit automatisieren: Skripte und kleine Tools mit Claude Code oder vergleichbaren Werkzeugenbauen, Runbooks und Dokumentation KI-gestützt aktuell halten, wiederkehrende IT-Anfragen überAssistenten abfangen. Erste Anlaufstelle für IT-Fragen im Team und Koordination externer Dienstleister und Software-Anbieter. Qualifikation Mehrjährige, nachweisbare Praxis in der Administration von Microsoft 365 und Entra ID in einem laufendenUnternehmen. Diese Stelle ist kein Einstieg in das Thema: Wir brauchen jemanden, der das schonverantwortet hat. Du hast schon einmal eine Mail-Umgebung aufgesetzt oder saniert und weißt, wie SPF, DKIM und DMARCzusammenwirken und was passiert, wenn sie es nicht tun. Sicherer Umgang mit DNS und Domainverwaltung. Scripting mit PowerShell oder Microsoft Graph, genug, um Abläufe zu automatisieren statt sie zu klicken. KI gehört zu deinem Arbeitsalltag: Du nutzt Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot oder Vergleichbares für Skripte,Analysen und Dokumentation und kannst konkret sagen, was du damit schon automatisiert hast. Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du dokumentierst, was du tust, und meldest dich, bevor etwaseskaliert. Klare Kommunikation auf Deutsch mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die keine Techniker sind. Nice to have: HubSpot oder ein vergleichbares CRM auf Admin-Seite, KI-Coding-Werkzeuge (ClaudeCode, Cursor) oder Automatisierungsplattformen (Make, Power Automate), MCP-Anbindungen und KI-Assistenten auf Unternehmensdaten, Tenant-Migrationen, Grundkenntnisse in Informationssicherheit undDatenschutz (ISO 27001, BSI-Grundschutz). Microsoft-Zertifizierungen wie MS-102 oder SC-300 sindwillkommen, ersetzen aber keine Praxis. Benefits Ein Aufgabenfeld, das du selbst ordnest, mit kurzem Draht zur Geschäftsführung und zumEntwicklungsteam. Ein Umfeld, das KI nicht diskutiert, sondern einsetzt. Claude, Coding-Assistenten und Automatisierung sindbei uns Standardwerkzeuge, kein Pilotprojekt. Flexible Arbeitszeiten, vollständig mobiles Arbeiten, moderne Ausstattung. Attraktives Gehalt und Bonusmodelle. Fortbildungen, zum Beispiel Microsoft-Zertifizierungen. Regelmäßige Workations mit dem gesamten Team. Klingt nach dir? Dann lass uns reden.
