title: Broker Partnerships Lead
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐ Your mission Brokers play a structural role in how large and very large employers select, negotiate, and manage their health and prévoyance coverage. We're looking for a Broker Partnerships Lead to build and animate Alan's relationships with the brokers who operate in the Enterprise segment, turning Alan into a trusted, credible, and commercially compelling partner for those actors, and supporting our Enterprise Sales and Key Account Management teams. ⭐ Location On-site in Paris , Île-de-France. What makes this role genuinely unique You'll shape how one of Europe's fastest-growing health insurance companies builds its relationships with the brokers operating in the large and very large employer segment across France, and beyond. You'll have real ownership from day one and operate at the highest levels of the broker market. You'll shape Alan’s broker strategy and execute it. Alan is at an early stage of building this capability. The playbook is yours to define and scale. You'll work directly with Alan's Enterprise Sales, Key Account Management, Insurance, and Executive Leadership. ⭐ Your role Relationships & Presence Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with the brokers that sit between us and the largest employers in our markets (whether private or public), at senior and managing director level. Map the ecosystem, prioritize interlocutors, and design Alan's engagement strategy. Be the consistent Alan voice that brokers recognize: someone who shows up, follows through, and is known as easy to deal with without giving away what shouldn't be given. Partnership with Alan's Enterprise & Commercial work Be a partner to our Enterprise Sales and KAM teams on every broker situation: drive strategic decisions deal by deal and turn ecosystem knowledge into commercial leverage. Introduce the right broker contacts at the right moment in the commercial cycle, transforming relationship capital into pipeline access on large and very large accounts. Share Alan's value and positioning with broker partners to help them understand, represent, and actively promote Alan within their client portfolios. Hold the line on our non-negotiables while finding creative ways to make the collaboration work for both sides. Sector Engagement & Anticipation Follow the broker market at deal level and ecosystem level: who is growing, who is consolidating, where portfolio shifts are happening, and what it means for Alan's pipeline and positioning. Be a sharp, early internal voice on where the broker market is heading and on the implications for Alan's strategy, including on consolidation, regulation, and competitive dynamics. Build & Scale Knowledge base: Build and maintain a knowledge library on broker positions, portfolio footprints, engagement history, and contractual frameworks shared with Enterprise Sales and KAM teams to increase win rates. Framework & tools: Implement processes and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of our broker engagement and contract documentation (conventions de courtage, commission tracking, data sharing agreements). Collaboration: Share best practices with the broader Enterprise & Commercial team and contribute proven methodologies to their scaled commercial operations. Market intelligence: Provide competitive intelligence on how brokers position Alan vs. incumbents, how they advise clients on insurer selection, and where we are perceived as "difficult to work with" — and feed that back into product, pricing, and GTM strategy. ⭐ Is it you we’re looking for? You’ll be a great fit for this opportunity if you: Have at least 8 years of total experience working with or inside the broker ecosystem: at a broker or in an external partnership or distribution role at a health insurer or mutuelle Have legitimate credibility at senior broker level: ability to engage managing director and senior leadership at major brokers as a peer, built through a personal representative past or years of substantive deal-level engagement on the insurer or employer side Have deep knowledge of the broker ecosystem in the large and very large employer segment: how brokers operate, how they are compensated, how they advise clients, and how they influence insurer selection at this scale Have deep understanding of health and prévoyance insurance: the technical dimension (garanties, gestion, régimes, prévoyance) must be native, not learned on the job Have proven ability to build trust with broker counterparts from the insurer or employer side: long-game, trustworthy, discreet, commercially disciplined Demonstrate outstanding stakeholder management: calm, ego-free, able to represent Alan substantively without making it about yourself and equally able to hold firm positions internally when sales pressure pushes toward broker accommodation beyond our framework Demonstrate commercial impact from prior broker-related work: broker relationships that translated into material deal flow, pipeline access, or portfolio migration Are a self-starter: comfortable building from scratch in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with limited process and real autonomy Are ego-free and lever-minded: you accelerate others, you don't seek the spotlight For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the F-H level range . 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. Flexible office with hybrid setup . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish. Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). Transport . Generous transit benefit Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. Personal growth through coaching : At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture . Parental leave . Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. Important note: we hire people, not roles. If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman : Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements? Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application! 🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium , blog and Glassdoor page for more info. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: 🤝  Qui nous sommes Chez Moka.Care nous réinventons la façon de voir la santé mentale en entreprise. Nous croyons en des équipes qui se sentent bien pour une organisation saine. Concrètement, Moka.Care offre une solution complète de prévention en santé mentale : Nous accompagnons les salariés avec des sessions individuelles, une application de self-care et un outil de micro-learning intégré à Slack et Teams. Nous aidons les équipes RH avec une interface de data analytics automatisée et des conseils personnalisés d'experts. Où en sommes-nous actuellement ? Depuis décembre 2019, plus de 400 entreprises, dont L'Oréal, Spendesk et Engie, ont rejoint Moka.Care , bénéficiant à plus de 300 000 collaborateurs dans le monde entier. Nous avons levé 17,5 millions d'euros auprès d'investisseurs et de business angels de premier rang. Notre croyance fondamentale : l'excellence in care est notre obsession. La culture d'entreprise, ce n'est pas juste des jolis mots que l'on affiche sur les murs. Nous incarnons des valeurs tangibles : l’empathie comme fondement, un optimisme insatiable, une responsabilité partagée et de l’agilité.   🧑‍💻 Pourquoi nous avons besoin de toi  Au sein de l’équipe Marketing & Communication, et sous la responsabilité de Pauline, Responsable Communication & Marketing Produit, tu auras pour objectifs principaux de : Satisfaire et engager nos clients en communiquant sur nos innovations, en créant des supports et argumentaires pour nos consultants, et en coordonnant des événements pour notre communauté RH. Augmenter l’adoption de notre produit par nos utilisateurs (les salariés des entreprises clientes de Moka.Care) en créant des visuels percutants et en accompagnant nos consultants sur le terrain. Développer la notoriété de Moka.Care, en contribuant à des campagnes créatives et impactantes, qui valorisent notre expertise et notre raison d’être. Tu travailleras en collaboration très étroite avec nos consultants qui accompagnent nos clients au quotidien.   👉 Tes futures missions  Engagement clients Animer notre communauté de DRH via des événements premium : Club RH (Take.Care Connect), soirée d'été, webinars clients centrés sur le produit Moka... Partager les nouvelles fonctionnalités et nouvelles offres à nos clients via des newsletters, des emails et des communications dans la plateforme RH. Créer des slides et des éléments de langage précis pour aider nos consultants à vendre nos offres et présenter nos nouveautés. Engagement utilisateurs Participer aux événements de lancement et stands dans les entreprises pour présenter Moka.Care aux salariés. Créer des posters, des vidéos, des goodies et tous types de supports visuels pour donner envie aux salariés d’utiliser Moka.Care. Communiquer auprès de nos utilisateurs sur les atouts de l'app et ses nouvelles fonctionnalités, via des emails dédiés, des notifications in-app... Notoriété et thought leadership Rédiger des communiqués de presse et des tribunes pour renforcer la visibilité médiatique de Moka.Care. Produire des contenus (interviews vidéos, pages du site, slides...) pour valoriser nos histoires clients. Participer à l'élaboration de campagnes de marque et d'actions d'influence pour faire rayonner notre expertise auprès de décideurs stratégiques.   L'entraide est très importante chez Moka. De temps en temps, tu prêteras main forte aux autres membres de l'équipe Marketing & Communication sur des projets divers, par exemple : aider à l’organisation d’événements et webinaires de prospection, créer des contenus pour le blog, le site ou Linkedin... 📇  Tu es la personne idéale si  Tu as au moins  2 à 3 ans d’expérience en communication externe et/ou interne. Tu es à l'aise à l'oral , et sais adapter ton discours à des interlocuteurs corporate exigeants. Tu sais piloter des projets en autonomie , organiser tes priorités et prendre des initiatives. Tu fais preuve de  professionnalisme  et d’un vrai  sens de l’esthétique dans les contenus visuels que tu crées. Tu maîtrises un ou plusieurs outils de design  (nous utilisons  Figma ). Si tu as des compétences en montage vidéo , c’est un vrai plus. Tu as le sens du storytelling et du mot qui fait mouche. Tu disposes d’un  bon niveau d’anglais , te permettant de comprendre et traiter des communications professionnelles. 🚀  En nous rejoignant tu vas  Participer à une aventure entrepreneuriale avec une mission forte. Grandir en tant que personne et apprendre au sein d'une équipe humaine, exigeante et solidaire. Voir chaque jour l'impact concret de ton travail, et participer à notre ambition : devenir leader européen de la prévention en santé mentale au travail.  Aller sur le terrain, à la rencontre des utilisateurs et futurs utilisateurs de Moka.Care. Être responsable de tes objectifs dès le départ : nous recrutons des personnes pour nous mener un cran plus loin. 🤩 Nous prenons soin de toi Accès à M oka.Care   : app, sessions individuelles, formations mensuelles et la possibilité de tester les nouvelles fonctionnalités. Work-life balance : 60% au bureau (on veut passer du temps ensemble) et le reste en remote si tu le souhaites (2 jours / semaine ou 1 semaine / mois). Des bureaux très agréables à Bastille avec une salle de sport, un rooftop. Cagnotte May : 1500 euros net/an (125 euros net/mois). Swile pour les tickets restaurants à hauteur 10€ / jour. Gymlib , pour faire du sport; Politique de 7 semaines de congés payés / RTT. Leeto , pour des centaines d’avantages et de réductions, grâce à notre CSE. Mutuelle :  SideCare. 50% du pass Navigo ou Veligo. Mac ou windows? Tu choisis, on veut que tu te sentes à l’aise. Rémunération : Package annuel brut entre  43 200 euros et 47 200 euros annuel brut (fixe + cagnotte May) , selon nos grilles de rémunération en interne. Cette fourchette est donnée à titre indicatif : le positionnement précis sera défini en fonction de ton expérience, de tes compétences et de ton adéquation au poste, afin de garantir cohérence et équité interne. 🎤  Processus de recrutement Notre philosophie : un processus de recrutement équilibré, pensé pour te projeter dans ton futur quotidien de travail. 30 minutes de screening pour comprendre ton parcours et tes aspirations. Une première étude de cas pour évaluer tes compétences, et approfondir ton expérience. Une seconde étude de cas  pour te mettre en situation face à des enjeux client concrets. Un entretien Values fit  pour s’assurer mutuellement que notre cadre et nos valeurs te conviendront. Offre  et  reverse interview:  l’opportunité pour toi de nous poser toutes les questions importantes pour prendre ta décision. Entre chaque étape tu as un feedback et si besoin nous organisons également des échanges informels avec l’équipe. Poste ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap. As International Law School Manager, EMEA you will own the full lifecycle of Harvey's academic partnerships across your markets — signing new schools, building faculty and dean relationships, running trainings, launching ambassador programs, and driving the curriculum and on-campus embeds that make Harvey helpful to each institution with whom we work.

You will start by taking over account management of existing EMEA partner schools and then look to sign and expand our presence across the region. You report directly to the Head of Legal Partnerships, Law Schools (New York).

  • School Partnerships: Lead outreach, relationship development, and onboarding for EMEA law schools — from flagship institutions to smaller schools.

  • Account Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for every school in your portfolio — owning relationships with faculty, library staff, student organizations, and administrators across each partner institution.

description: <p>ANINE BING is seeking an <strong>RTW Freelance Fashion Designer</strong> for a mission-based engagement supporting ready-to-wear collection development, in coordination with our Paris-based design team.</p> <p>This mission covers design contribution across our RTW offer, with a <strong>priority focus on flou and tailoring</strong>, for designers who bring a versatile, hands-on skillset and <strong>a minimum of 3 years of professional experience</strong> in a fashion design studio.</p> <p><strong>Mission Scope:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Contribute to design and development across RTW categories, with a <strong>priority focus on flou and tailoring</strong> (jersey exposure a plus), aligned with agreed collection deliverables.</li> <li>Produce technical drawings and design packs on Illustrator, delivered per the agreed milestones.</li> <li>Contribute to silhouette refinement based on fitting feedback, incorporating revisions into technical drawings.</li> <li>Contribute to color, fabric and trim research to support collection deliverables.</li> <li>Ensure deliverables reflect brand design intent, for handoff to Product Development and Production.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Profile:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Minimum 3 years of professional experience</strong> in a fashion design studio, ideally within a contemporary or premium ready-to-wear brand.</li> <li>Strong design skillset in <strong>flou and tailoring</strong>; jersey experience a plus.</li> <li><strong>Expert-level command of Illustrator and Photoshop is mandatory</strong>, with solid technical drawing and garment construction knowledge.</li> <li>Autonomous and able to manage deliverables independently against a defined scope and timeline.</li> <li>Fluent English required; French professional proficiency preferred.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Mission Terms</strong></p> <ul> <li>Independent contractor status (freelance / auto-entrepreneur or registered company); this is a service engagement, not an employment position.</li> <li>Substantial time commitment expected given the volume of deliverables across the collection cycle; scope, milestones and workload are defined with the Senior Designer, with day-to-day work organization managed by the contractor.</li> <li>Occasional on-site presence in Paris may be required for fittings; otherwise remote.</li> </ul> <p><strong>A portfolio is required to apply. Applications submitted without a portfolio cannot be considered.</strong></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

We’re looking for an Senior Account Executive to grow our footprint across France. You’ll be at the forefront of introducing Tandem’s clinician copilot to providers, partners, and health systems - shaping how we scale across France

This is a pivotal role where you’ll forge high-impact partnerships across the care ecosystem, from provider networks and EHR vendors to resellers and health insurers. You’ll act as a market expert, relationship builder, and operator all in one.

What you will do

  • Identify, initiate, and manage key relationships across the healthcare landscape in France.

  • Open doors with provider groups, EHR vendors, system integrators, payors, and commercial resellers to accelerate Tandem’s reach and adoption.

  • Pitch, negotiate, and close deals that deliver strategic value, working closely with legal, product, and commercial teams to get contracts across the line.

  • Represent Tandem externally in meetings, events, and conferences, positioning us as a trusted digital health partner.

  • Bring the voice of the market back into Tandem, sharing insights that inform product development, regulatory priorities, and local go-to-market strategy.

  • Help build the customer success and support infrastructure that ensures our partners thrive with Tandem.

What You Bring

  • Proven experience with healthcare partnerships, sales, or business development - ideally in health-tech, med-tech, with familiarity of the hospital ecosystem

  • A strong track record of closing strategic partnerships in complex, regulated environments with providers, EHRs, or pharmaceutical companies.

  • Deep knowledge of the French hospital ecosystem - from payors and providers to health IT vendors and regional nuances.

  • A strong local network and ability to build trusted relationships across stakeholder groups.

  • Comfortable navigating clinical, commercial, and technical conversations.

  • Fluent in French and English, with excellent communication skills.

  • Independent operator with the ability to collaborate closely with cross-functional teams.

  • Passion for improving healthcare delivery through thoughtful, impactful innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working with or selling into EHR providers, health systems, or care delivery platforms.

  • Background in medtech, digital health, healthcare

  • Familiarity with EU/French regulatory and compliance environments.

  • Experience in startup or high-growth environments, especially launching new markets.


What we offer

  • Competitive salary, reviewed as you grow, plus stock options

  • 30 days of holiday

  • Paid parental leave

  • €1,000 annual health & wellbeing budget, plus mental-health support whenever you need it

  • A real learning budget and internal growth paths - build your career without leaving Tandem

  • Fully AI native company - let our agents do the grunt work

  • Two company off-sites a year, plus a team budget for the things that bring you closer

  • State of the art office in the heart of Paris, and your choice of IT equipment

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This is a full-time role based in Paris, France. You’ll travel regularly - either to meet clinicians around France or to collaborate with our team in Stockholm.

  2. First interview with our Country Director in France

  3. Working Day - Join us in the Paris office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

  • Operational forecasting

  • Cleaning and maintenance automation

We're looking for an ambitious Product Engineer who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. You'll work closely with founders, designers, and operators to identify what matters, build solutions, and improve them based on how people use them.

What You'll Build

As a Product Engineer, you'll help shape and scale Base360.ai across the entire short-term rental lifecycle.

You'll build customer-facing features, operational dashboards, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, and integrations that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting.

Your Mission

Understand Customer Problems

Work directly with property managers and internal teams to understand their workflows, identify friction, and decide which problems are worth solving.

Build Products End-to-End

Take features from idea and prototype through frontend, backend, integrations, testing, and deployment. Own the complete experience and how it performs in production.

Create Intuitive User Experiences

Work with designers to make complex short-term rental operations easy to manage. Build interfaces that help users complete tasks quickly and confidently.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Features

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Connect the Ecosystem

Build reliable APIs and integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Solve Real Operational Problems

Build solutions for:

  • Real-time reservation and availability synchronization

  • Dynamic pricing intelligence

  • Smart lock access and key management

  • Automated guest communication across channels

  • Guest check-in and upsell journeys

  • Operational forecasting

  • Cleaning and maintenance automation

  • Owner reporting and financial workflows

  • AI-powered monitoring and alerts

Measure and Improve

Use customer feedback, product usage, and operational results to evaluate what you ship. Improve features based on adoption, time saved, fewer errors, and better user outcomes.

Build for Scale

Make sound technical decisions that balance delivery speed, maintainability, security, and reliability as more operators and properties join the platform.

Tech Stack

We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes:

  • Python

  • FastAPI

  • React

  • TypeScript

  • Supabase

  • PostgreSQL

  • AWS

  • Serverless architecture

  • OpenAI APIs

  • Twilio

  • Stripe

  • Docker

  • GitHub Actions

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have

  • Strong experience building and shipping production software

  • The ability to work across frontend and backend systems

  • Experience with React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, or similar technologies

  • Strong understanding of APIs, databases, integrations, and cloud architecture

  • A product mindset and curiosity about why users need a feature

  • Good judgment around usability, scope, and technical trade-offs

  • The ability to turn an ambiguous problem into a practical, working solution

  • Confidence working directly with customers, designers, and founders

  • The ability to work independently and own outcomes

  • Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational efficiency

  • A bias toward shipping, learning, and iterating

Bonus points for experience with:

  • Short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or property management systems

  • Multi-tenant SaaS platforms

  • Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations

  • AI agents and workflow automation

  • Product analytics and experimentation

  • Event-driven architectures

  • Supabase

  • AWS serverless infrastructure

  • Customers spend less time on manual administration and repetitive tasks

  • Complex workflows become easier to understand and complete

  • Integrations move reservations, availability, payments, and operational data reliably

  • Customer feedback and usage data consistently inform your product decisions

Learn Faster

Remote-First

Work from anywhere. We care about outcomes, not hours.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

Please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com or @talent.camunda.com. We will never ask candidates for bank account details, checks, payment, or other sensitive financial information as part of our hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.

Note for recruiting and placement agencies: Camunda does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site, employees, or any other Camunda contact unless we have specifically engaged your firm for that search. Camunda will not pay fees related to unsolicited resumes.
